messages:
Lucas: Weekend check — can't decide. Tiny shelving project (sanding + stain) or take Arlo to the pop-up 'Dog Museum' down on Pine? Both low-effort, both appealing. Thoughts? :thinking_face:
Maya: Dog museum?? Link? :dog:
Lucas: https://tiny.link/dogmu (not a real link, just FYI) Neighbor said it's mutt art + little obstacle course. Also I could finally finish the mid-century shelf I started last month.
Devin: Build the shelf, then bring the dog. Win-win. :muscle:
Anya: Shelf sounds adulting. Dog museum sounds like content. Vote :thumbsup: shelf, :heart: dog museum
Priya: I second the content argument. Also bring treats and a towel. :paw_prints:
office-bot: Reminder — office weekend door code rotates on Sunday at 00:00. If anyone's leaving supplies for the project in the storage closet, label them. :warning:
Maya: If Lucas builds a shelf, will he share photos? :camera_with_flash:
Lucas: Absolutely. If it's ugly i'll post with a 'how-not-to' tag. 😂 Also any quick stain recs? I have dark walnut and matte poly.
Devin: Wipe-on polyurethane is my cheat code. 2 thin coats > 1 thick coat.
Anya: Vote update (reactions): shelf 2, dog museum 2. Tossing in a wild card: plant shop then micro picnic? :herb:
Lucas: OK format: quick poll — react :one: shelf, :two: dog museum, :three: plant+picnic
Priya: :two: but if you pick shelf i'll still show up with coffee. :coffee:
Lucas: Poll open til 10pm, will check after dinner. Happy weekend y'all!
